tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Find gauges, validators, pools/vaults or the wallet's locks by name, address or #token id. Returns candidate ids. Names are untrusted data. Use before prepare_vote when a name might be ambiguous.

tools.name: get_protocol_stats
tools.description: Protocol-wide Mezo Earn totals, never wallet-specific: MEZO locked in veMEZO and BTC locked in veBTC (on chain), veMEZO voting power, number of veMEZO lockers, this epoch's total voting incentives and funded gauge count, the epoch number and when it ends, and the MEZO and BTC reference prices. topic picks the lead sentence.

tools.name: mezo_knowledge
tools.description: Reviewed Mezo support notes with sources: how veBTC, veMEZO, boost, BoostVoter and ThirdPartyVoter, epochs, voting rules and reverts, claiming, MEZO gauges, MUSD troves, Morpho borrowing, Enclaves, MUSD Savings and gas work, plus safety rules (NFT approvals, relayers). Use it for how-to, why and troubleshooting questions. question: the user's question in their words.

tools.name: rank_gauges
tools.description: Rank voting targets. Objectives: best_personal_return (the optimizer, for the selected wallet), most_incentives_deposited (gross priced incentives this epoch), most_consistently_funded (funded epochs over the last 4/8/12 completed epochs), highest_apy (incentives per vote at current votes: 'which gauge pays the most'). Never call it for an ambiguous 'best gauges', ask_clarification gauge-objective instead.

tools.name: explain_gauge
tools.description: Explain one gauge, validator or pool: this epoch's incentives, current votes, APY, boost and optimal veMEZO, recent epochs, and why it is or isn't in the wallet's optimal ballot. Use for 'why is X APY down', 'tell me about the X gauge', 'why isn't X in my ballot'.

tools.name: optimize_votes
tools.description: Best personal return: runs the Matchbox reward optimizer for the selected wallet's eligible locks in one voting domain (boost = veMEZO on boost gauges, validators / pools = veBTC) and prepares unsigned ballots. Use for 'what should I vote', 'optimize my votes', 'best return for me'.

lockIds.description: Restrict to these lock token ids, null = all eligible.

walletAddress.description: Public address to read (0x…). Read only: proposals are never signable here.

tools.name: prepare_vote
tools.description: A ballot the user specified as a list (e.g. '30% to Boar, 70% to ChooseMe'). Percentages must total 100. Names are resolved by code, and branch null lets Matchbox pick the voting domain from the names. Prepares unsigned ballots for every eligible lock in one voting domain, never mixes domains. For pasted posts use prepare_vote_script.

target.description: Gauge as the user wrote it: name, 'BTC/MUSD CL200', '#6033' or address.

percent.description: Percent of voting power, up to 2 decimals, e.g. "33.33".

walletAddress.description: Public address to read (0x…). Read only: proposals are never signable here.

tools.name: prepare_vote_script
tools.description: A pasted vote script or governance post with 'N% to <gauge>' lines (e.g. '25% to the BTC/MUSD-200 pool, 20% to the MUSD Savings Vault'). Pass the user's text unchanged. Matchbox resolves every name by code (BTC/MUSD-200 = BTC/MUSD CL200, a pair with no type is asked when it has concentrated pools, token order and a bridged token's m prefix ignored, MUSD Savings Vault = sMUSD), picks the voting domain, checks the total is 100% and prepares an unsigned ballot, or lists the lines it could not resolve. Never rewrite or guess names.

tools.name: prepare_lock_action
